title: Nightcrawler
approach: -1 when k < #leaves. A vertex set can be the set of subset-maxima iff |S ∩ subtree(v)| <= leaves(v) for all v — a laminar matroid — so sort by value descending and keep each vertex that still has a free leaf slot below it; the rejected values in descending order are exactly the increments for k > L.

techniques.label: greedy
techniques.why: the matroid makes the descending greedy optimal

verified: matched all 7 samples and 300 random trees against a brute-force partition enumerator
